items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: And we had hired Professor Dalmas, I guess you know him.

ctx.x: Small bell, yeah. And I ordered that horn. That horn cost me $225 at that time. And I kept that horn until I went on the bass. But I was forced on the bass overnight. Yeah, we had a funeral for the Young Men Olympia. And Dominic Raimi was leading the band at that time, which we called him T-Boy. And we had hired Professor Dalmas, I guess you know him.
